paragraphs.text: Sunhome is the Guildhall and primary stronghold of the Boros on Ravnica . It serves as a fortress, barracks, and spiritual heart for the Legion’s devoted soldiers. Widely called the Fortress of the Legion, Sunhome stands as an impregnable symbol of Boros' strength and unwavering resolve.

Sunhome is a combined fortress, barracks, and spiritual center for the Boros Legion's devoted soldiers. The massive structure, often called the Fortress of the Legion , is widely regarded as impregnable and stands as a permanent reminder to would-be invaders of the unshakable resolve and strength of the Boros guild.

More than just a military base, Sunhome also houses the headquarters of the League of Wojek , the Boros’ law enforcement arm that keeps order throughout the Tenth District. The fortress is constantly guarded by elite veterans known as the Sunhome Guard , who serve as both protectors of the guildhall and as a symbol of Boros discipline and vigilance.
Sunhome's presence looms large over Precinct Four, reminding both allies and enemies that the Boros Legion will always stand ready to defend the city against threats from within and beyond.
